notes: «حدثنا أبي» opens with the compiler's father as a bare relation link; the gloss «- رحمه الله -» is left out
«يرفعه إلى أبي عبد الله» names the Imam inside the chain after «يرفعه إلى», not after «عن», so he is read as the last link of the chain, kind narrator
«قال: قلت: قبل نظره» has an unnamed questioner («قلت»); whether he is a link is not settled by rule 6, so it is left for ruling
